ns2:section.sectionText: What?s your favorite brand? Nike? The North Face? AT&T? Kim Kardashian? Why? How does the brand cultivate your relationship? Why does what works for some brands fail miserably for others? This course is designed to address these and related questions. Its goal is to sensitize you to the ongoing challenges faced by even the most successful brand managers in their attempts to build and sustain meaningful customer-brand connections. The class is for anyone interested in understanding how and why brands create and embody value for firms.
